algorithms.name: Linear Discriminant Analysis (Supervised Variant)
algorithms.notes: Learn a supervised low-dimensional projection that separates labeled classes. Meaningful supervised dimensionality-reduction variant of Linear Discriminant Analysis. It returns a learned projection or transformed observations rather than classifier predictions. Document class-label requirements, projection dimension bounds, and shared mathematical background with the classification variant. Phase 0 planning record only; the full algorithm documentation, implementations, usage examples, and tests remain pending.

algorithms.name: Vanilla Autoencoders
algorithms.notes: Learn reconstruction-based latent representations, including bottleneck dimensionality reduction. Canonical scope is a basic reconstruction autoencoder, including a bottleneck representation for dimensionality reduction. B5 and B7 share this foundation; denoising, sparse, and variational autoencoders remain distinct requested variants. The canonical folder is under B7 deep learning. Phase 0 planning record only; the full algorithm documentation, implementations, usage examples, and tests remain pending.
